name: Carlos
source:
Carlos is easily the cutest and most devilish creature mankind has ever had the pleasure of receiving.

Carlos is Akihiko's pet raccoon! He's adorable, but at the same time, highly unpredictable; one day he wants attention and love, the next he's biting Akihiko until he dies of something.

[From [url=https://stefannofornari-games.itch.io/dont-give-up-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
